Terms of Use

Last updated: 17 October 2026

  1. Service. US is an app for couples, provided by Moonee Lab (Francesco Monti), email moonee.team@gmail.com. It lets two people share moments, messages, photos, voice notes, games and other activities in a private space. Version 1.0 is a first version: some features may change.
  2. Price. In this first version US is free, for both of you. If we add paid features in the future, they will be optional and we will tell you first, with the prices.
  3. Age. You must be at least 18 to use US. You confirm this when you sign up, together with accepting these terms and the privacy policy. We close accounts that turn out to belong to minors.
  4. Account. You are responsible for keeping your login details confidential. A couple space is made of two accounts. Either of you can leave the couple at any time without deleting your account: the space closes straight away and sharing stops.
  5. Content. The content you post remains yours. You only give us permission to store it and show it to your partner so the app can work.
  6. What is not allowed. You may not post or send:
    • illegal content;
    • content that shows or involves minors in a sexual or otherwise harmful way;
    • intimate images or content of other people without their consent;
    • content that infringes other people’s rights;
    • threats, harassment or content that incites violence.
    You also may not try to access other couples’ data, get around the app’s protections, or use the app to monitor or stalk anyone.
  7. Reports and removal. You can report a problem or a piece of content to us from Settings › App and support › Report a problem or content, or by writing to moonee.team@gmail.com. We look into every report. If content or an account breaks these terms, we may remove the content, suspend or close the account and, where the law requires it, inform the authorities.
  8. Third-party services. Music search and the music player are provided by Spotify, under Spotify’s own terms.
  9. Availability. We do our best to keep US working, but the service is provided “as is” and may have interruptions. To the extent allowed by law, we are not liable for data loss or indirect damage. This does not affect your mandatory rights as a consumer.
  10. Suspension. We may suspend an account that breaks these terms, telling you first where possible. In the case of illegal content or a risk to someone, we may act straight away.
  11. Ending the relationship. You can delete your account at any time. How we handle your data is described in the privacy policy.
  12. Changes. We will tell you in the app about important changes to these terms.
  13. Governing law. Italian law. For consumers, the courts of the place where the consumer lives have jurisdiction.
  14. Contact. moonee.team@gmail.com
